observation.visible_scene: A pour-over coffee station on a wooden board: a cone dripper holding a wet coffee bed sits atop a glass server containing dark brewed coffee with a pale foam ring at its surface; the server rests on a black digital scale showing blue LED digits. A wooden 'COMANDANTE' hand grinder stands at left, a gooseneck kettle spout is partly visible behind the dripper, and a white cup plus kitchen cabinets and a stand mixer fill the background.
visible_changes: The coffee bed inside the dripper and the liquid level in the server stay essentially constant across the segment; no new pour or emptying is seen.
The pale foam/bubble band on the surface of the coffee in the server shows small, continuous shifts in bubble pattern, consistent with an ongoing slow drip from the dripper above.
A thin drip/stream is intermittently visible at the center outlet of the dripper over the server.
The grinder, kettle spout, scale body, cup, and background remain fixed; the camera framing does not move.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether water is being actively poured into the dripper (no pouring hand or kettle stream into the cone is visible in this excerpt).
The start and end of the brew cycle; the segment is a mid-process slice.
Whether the scale reading is incrementing (the LED text is too low-resolution to track reliably).
uncertain_details: Exact drip rate and whether the foam movement is from dripping or from settling.
Precise values and any change on the scale display.
Minor apparent differences in the dripper's water level between frames (likely compression/blur rather than real change).
